title: Does a new friend tighten Ana's circle?
hook: 3 of the 6 pairs among Ana's friends are friends. New friend Fay joins. Tighter or looser?

doesNotKnow: that clustering is the share of a person's friend pairs who are friends, and that a new friend adds new pairs to the bottom of that share

misconception: A new friend who knows some of your friends makes your circle tighter.
objective: The learner can say that when Fay, knowing 1 of Ana's 4 friends, joins, Ana's clustering falls from 0.5 to 0.4, because Fay adds 4 new pairs to the bottom of the share and only 1 linked pair to the top, and that she must know 2 of the 4 just to keep 0.5.

claims.text: Before Fay, Ana's 4 friends make 6 pairs, of which 3 (B–C, C–D, D–E) are friends with each other: Ana's clustering is 3 of 6 = 0.5.
claims.source: C(4,2) = 6 pairs; linked B–C, C–D, D–E. Node check J2 in company/courses/ncm/briefs.md (before 0.5). Demo.tsx network(null).

claims.text: With Fay as a fifth friend, Ana's friends make 10 pairs, 4 of them new (Fay with each old friend); if Fay knows 1, 2 or 3 of the four, Ana's clustering is 4 of 10 = 0.4, 5 of 10 = 0.5 or 6 of 10 = 0.6, so Fay must know at least 2 of the 4 to keep it at 0.5. Recall: a newcomer who knows none of the 4 leaves 3 linked pairs of 10 = 0.3.
claims.source: C(5,2) = 10; linked pairs 3 + k for a newcomer knowing k of the 4: (3 + k)/10. Node check J2 in company/courses/ncm/briefs.md (fayKnows 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6 for k = 0 to 3). Demo.tsx network(1|2|3). No chip shows k = 0; it appears only in the recall.

claims.text: A person's clustering (clustering coefficient) is the share of pairs of their friends who are friends with each other: linked pairs over all pairs.
claims.source: Easley & Kleinberg (2010), Networks, Crowds, and Markets, ch. 3 (section 3.1 unconfirmed): clustering coefficient of a node. Watts & Strogatz (1998), Nature 393: 440–442 (local clustering coefficient). Attribution: fact-checker confirms.

recall.question: Raj has 4 friends, and 3 of their 6 pairs know each other. A new friend joins who knows none of the 4. What happens to the share of Raj's friend pairs who are friends?
recall.why: The newcomer adds 4 new pairs and none of them are friends, so the share falls from 3 of 6 to 3 of 10.
